shield.author: Jochi SFX
shield.license: Jochi SFX free-use terms (video description): "You can use these sounds for free in any musical compositions, video projects and other creative work. You may not sell or re-distribute these sounds, nor claim them as your own work."
shield.note: NOT committed (clause 2 forbids redistribution; only the transformed sprite ships). Rebuild the cache file from the clip: yt-dlp -f bestaudio -x --audio-format wav <page>, then ffmpeg -i clip.wav -filter_complex "[0:a]atrim=start=1.30:duration=0.75,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a];[0:a]atrim=start=3.18:duration=0.75,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[0:a]atrim=start=5.10:duration=0.75,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[c];[a][b][c]concat=n=3:v=0:a=1[o]" -map [o] -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a flac -compression_level 8 artifacts/audio/source-cache/shield.flac — the sha256 above must match. Used as the parry cue at pitch 1.

slashkill.note: NOT committed. Rebuild: yt-dlp -f bestaudio -x --audio-format wav <page>; ffmpeg -i clip.wav -af "atrim=start=0:duration=1.6,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS" -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a flac -compression_level 8 artifacts/audio/source-cache/slashkill.flac — sha256 above must match. Owner picked it 2026-09-21 (option 6 of six). hit_flesh/hit_heavy variants at pitch 1.
